chunks: When the earth is stretched out taut
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the earth is stretched out on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Ba'th* (Resurrection), where the Earth's flattening signifies the removal of earthly barriers and the preparation of a vast, level arena for the universal gathering of humanity. Scholars such as Al-Tabarsi highlight this as a sign of God's absolute power to reverse natural laws, serving as a tangible reminder of the impending *Hisab* (accounting) where every soul will stand before the Divine.
